result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back from all the listings you named. The full offline suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`, no failures).

What changed:
- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(255)` column on `promotion`. Existing rows get none.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: new last record component `description`, null when absent.
- **`DataStore.java`**: `createPromotion` writes the description. `findPromotionByCode`, `listPromotionsActiveOn`, `listPromotionsActiveOnInRegion`, `listPromotionsByCategory`, `findBestPromotion` and `listUnusedPromotions` select it and pass it into the record.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled. The existing 5-argument method delegates with null, so the demo and the other tests didn't need changing.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionOnEveryPromotionListing` test. It creates a SUMMER promotion with the description and a WINTER one without, then checks each listing and both store lookups.

The edits went through the edit tool because shell writes to `DataStore.java` needed approval. Nothing is committed.
